metadata.source: TSR 9039 - A1 Slave Pits of the Undercity (David Cook, 1980)

adventure.title: A1: Slave Pits of the Undercity
adventure.summary: Infiltrate the ruined temple compound in the despoiled city of Highport. Bypass the spring-trap entrance, navigate the basilisk den, slay the Slaver Captain in the Earth Dragon temple, plunge through the flooded sewers, and liberate the captives.

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A narrow 5ft stone vestibule terminating at the rear masonry of the ruined temple. Faint yellow light seeps through hairline cracks around an unpainted wooden door.
gmNotes: Rigged with a spring-loaded spiked bar trap across chest height (3d6 damage on trigger).
Can be disarmed with Sleight of Hand or cutting the trigger cord through the crack.

exits.listenNotice: Muffled guttural snoring and the scrape of iron against a whetstone.

interactables.label: Spiked Spring-Bar Trap
interactables.description: A heavy wooden bar bristling with iron spikes and broken bottle glass, drawn back under tremendous tension by a hemp cord.

hazards.description: Snapping iron-spiked timber bar sweeping chest level across the doorway

sensoryCues.smell: Charred timber, old ash, and wet masonry
sensoryCues.sound: Distant thumping and coarse humanoid laughter
sensoryCues.draft: Warm stale air whistling through the door cracks

narrative.playerFacingDescription: Blackened rafters lean against broken stone pillars. Charred tables and shattered pottery lie half-buried under fallen plaster and tiles.
gmNotes: Connects west to the bricked-up basilisk chamber and north into the active slaver barracks.

exits.listenNotice: Harsh commands barked in Orcish and the heavy clang of dice cups on oak.

interactables.label: Sift Charred Guard Debris
interactables.description: Underneath a collapsed beam is a blackened leather satchel containing 15 silver coins and a brass key ring.

sensoryCues.smell: Acrid charcoal and stale tobacco smoke
sensoryCues.sound: Creaking overhead floor joists under shifting weight

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A soot-caked cell sealed off with freshly mortared limestone blocks. Crudely chiseled skull symbols and the word 'PETRIFY' are scratched into the stone face.
gmNotes: Reinforced partition wall containing the two wild basilisks roaming Area 10.

interactables.label: Loose Mortar Inspection Chink
interactables.description: Peering through a gap in the mortar reveals a courtyard garden with lifelike statues of screaming men frozen in stone.

sensoryCues.smell: Dry chalky lime mortar and a dead reptilian musk
sensoryCues.sound: Scratching stone claws scraping the opposite side of the barrier

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A large rectangular hall converted into quarters for slaver mercenaries. Double-deck wooden bunks line the walls, and a large embossed bronze alarm gong hangs near the northern archway.
gmNotes: Occupied by 3 Half-Orc Slavers.
If not eliminated or silenced, one will attempt to ring the gong to summon courtyard reinforcements.

exits.listenNotice: Wind howling across a wide open flagstone courtyard.

interactables.label: Bronze Alarm Gong & Mallet
interactables.description: A heavy beaten bronze disk capable of ringing an alarm across the entire temple complex.

interactables.label: Mercenary Weapons Rack
interactables.description: Holds notched broadswords, light crossbows, and bolts stamped with the Slave Lords' brand.

encounter.tactics: One slaver falls back toward the alarm gong while the others draw scimitars and form a defensive screen.

sensoryCues.smell: Sweat, unwashed wool bedding, and tallow candle wax
sensoryCues.sound: Shouting half-orcs and heavy iron boot treads

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A semicircular stone alcove with narrow arrow slits looking out across the burnt city streets of Highport and the inner temple courtyard.
gmNotes: Contains a signal horn and spyglass.

interactables.label: Brass Sentry Horn
interactables.description: A curved brass horn on a leather sling used to signal approaching merchant caravans or hostile incursions.

sensoryCues.draft: Cool ocean breeze blowing through the defensive arrow embrasures

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A vast open-air courtyard paved in cracked granite flagstones. To the north rises the imposing pillared facade of the Great Temple of the Earth Dragon. To the east lie tangled overgrown gardens.
gmNotes: Central transit hub of the upper complex. Wandering slaver patrols cross here.

exits.listenNotice: Distant resonant drumming and low ritual chanting in an unknown blasphemous tongue.

interactables.label: Dry Stone Dragon Fountain
interactables.description: A carved draconic maw protruding from a dry stone basin. Sifting through debris uncovers a healing potion vial.

sensoryCues.smell: Dust, dry weeds, and distant burning incense from the temple sanctum
sensoryCues.sound: Cawing gulls circling overhead and echoing boots

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A choked, unkempt cloister garden where thorny briars and wild climbing vines have overrun stone benches and statuary.
gmNotes: Gated archway leads to the walled Basilisk Den (Area 10).

exits.listenNotice: Heavy scaly bellies dragging slowly over gravel.

interactables.label: Gnarled Briar Bush
interactables.description: Dense thorny underbrush that catches on armor and clothes. Clearing it reveals a rusted iron chest.

sensoryCues.smell: Dank mulch, blooming nightshade, and bitter resin
sensoryCues.sound: Insects buzzing and dry branches snapping underfoot

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A secluded walled courtyard littered with gnawed bones and six extraordinarily lifelike stone statues of human adventurers in contorted poses of sheer horror.
gmNotes: Lair of two Lesser Basilisks with deadly petrifying gaze.
One petrified warrior wears a glowing silver ring of protection.

interactables.label: Petrified Adventurer with Ring
interactables.description: A stone statue of an elf warrior shielding his face. On his stone finger glints an intact magical band.

encounter.tactics: Basilisks focus their glowing pale eyes on intruders, demanding Constitution saves to avert petrification.

hazards.description: Gaze of the Basilisk forcing characters to avert eyes or risk turning to solid stone

sensoryCues.sound: Scaly bellies rasping over coarse gravel

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A gutted longhouse where temple initiates once slept. Sunlight filters through gaping holes in the charred slate roof.
gmNotes: Passage west leads to the suspicious False Slavers' Lair (Area 12).

exits.listenNotice: Pitiful moans and sobbing pleas for rescue.

sensoryCues.smell: Charred damp timbers and musty straw
sensoryCues.draft: Down-drafts from roof holes stirring old soot

narrative.playerFacingDescription: Two figures tied to wooden support posts weep and beg for assistance, crying out that the slavers will soon return.
gmNotes: Trap! These are two Doppleganger infiltrators posing as captives to lower the party's guard.
They strike once untied or when characters turn their backs.

interactables.label: Bound 'Captives'
interactables.description: Two disheveled humans in tattered clothes bound with loose hemp ropes. An Insight check detects fraudulent sobs.

encounter.tactics: The false captives burst from their ropes with inhuman strength, morphing into gray-skinned horrors with razor claws.

sensoryCues.sound: Sobbing that stops abruptly when approached

locations.label: 18. Great Temple of the Earth Dragon

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A cavernous temple hall dominated by a colossal stone statue of the coiled Earth Dragon with glowing amber eyes. Below the idol stands a blood-stained sacrificial slab, overseen by the Slaver Captain in black plate armor.
gmNotes: Boss encounter of the Temple Level.
Captain carries the Master Slave Key and the Dragon Brand Crossbow.
Concealed flagstone trapdoor behind the idol leads down into the Flooded Sewers (Area 15) and Slave Pens (Area 16).

exits.listenNotice: Splashing murky water and distant metallic clanking of slave chains.

interactables.label: Colossal Earth Dragon Idol
interactables.description: Massive stone carving of a coiled wingless dragon. Its right eye holds a fist-sized amber gemstone that can be pried loose.

encounter.tactics: The Captain fires his enchanted heavy crossbow from the altar steps while his guards engage in melee.

sensoryCues.smell: Pungent incense, tallow, and dried blood on the altar stone
sensoryCues.sound: Low reverberating chanting and crackling brazier coals

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A vaulted subterranean aqueduct flooded with four feet of black, sluggish wastewater. Debris floats along the current, and slime coats the slippery stone ledges.
gmNotes: Aquatic hazard: water extinguishes non-magical torches dropped below waist level.
A vicious swamp crocodile lurks beneath the surface.

exits.listenNotice: Desperate whispers and the rhythmic clinking of iron prisoner manacles.

encounter.tactics: The crocodile lunges from beneath the dark water to drag a character into the deeper canal.

hazards.description: Waist-deep filthy wastewater concealing slippery drop-offs and jagged debris

sensoryCues.smell: Stagnant sludge, decaying vegetable matter, and sulfur
sensoryCues.sound: Sloshing water and dark ripples echoing down the culvert

narrative.playerFacingDescription: A damp cavern lined with heavy iron-barred holding cells. Inside huddled groups of ragged captives look up with fearful eyes, bound in heavy iron manacles.
gmNotes: Primary quest objective: liberate the slaves of Highport.
Gwenneth the Elven Scout and Merchant Markham are held in Cell 3.
Unlocking the cages completes the quest and yields loyal NPC allies.

interactables.label: Slave Holding Cages & Manacles
interactables.description: Heavy rusted iron cages holding 18 starving captives. The master slave key opens all cell gates and manacles simultaneously.

sensoryCues.sound: Soft weeping giving way to gasps of hope as cell gates are unlocked

items.name: Pouch of 15 Silver Pieces
items.description: Salvaged coin pouch containing fifteen minted silver coins.

items.name: Slaver Barracks Key
items.description: Crude heavy iron key carried by the half-orc mercenaries.

items.name: Master Slave Key of Highport
items.description: Elaborate black iron key stamped with the symbol of the Slave Lords. Opens all slave pens.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow +1
items.description: Magically reinforced steel crossbow with dark wood stock, deadly accurate at long range.

items.name: Elixir of Neutralize Poison
items.description: Golden vial of herbal liquid that counters venom and restores vitality.

items.name: Potion of Extra Healing
items.description: Potent restorative draught healing 3d8+3 hit points.

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description: Silver band conferring +1 to AC and all saving throws.

items.name: Jeweled Amber Dragon Eye
items.description: Fist-sized flawless amber gemstone pried from the Earth Dragon idol.

items.name: Slave Lords' Shipping Manifest
items.description: Secret parchment detailing slave shipments sent to A2: Secret of the Slavers' Stockade.

monsters.name: Slaver Captain of the Earth Temple

npcs.name: Gwenneth the Elven Scout
npcs.dialogueText: Praise the gods! You broke the captain's iron ring! Hand me a bow and I will guide you straight to their stockade in the hills.

npcs.name: Merchant Markham
npcs.dialogueText: I am Markham of Highport! Get us out of this foul pit and my trade guild will reward you with 200 gold pieces!

quests.title: A1: Liberate the Slave Pits of the Undercity
quests.description: Infiltrate the ruined Earth Dragon temple in Highport, defeat the Slaver Captain, obtain the master key, and liberate the captive slaves from the flooded subterranean pens.
